
// (type type)
type Type_type struct {
 type_any       *Type_any
 type_generic   *Type_generic
 P_path         string
 P_pkgname      string
 P_name         string
 P_idx          int
 P_extends      *Type_string
 P_empty        *Type_any
 P_propertylist *Type_varlist
 P_container    *Type_type
 P_allowtypes   *Type_typelist
 P_func         *Type_func
 P_isnative     bool
}

// V_type_constructor
func V_type_constructor() *Type_type {
 var output *Type_type = new(Type_type)
 return output
}

// V_type_create
func V_type_create() *Type_type {
 var output *Type_type = V_type_constructor()
 V_type_initialize(
  output)
 return output
}

// V_type_initialize
func V_type_initialize(
 value *Type_type) {
 value.type_any = V_any_from_type_backref(
  T_type,
  T_type)
 value.type_generic = E_generic
 value.P_path = ""
 value.P_pkgname = ""
 value.P_name = ""
 value.P_alias = ""
 value.P_idx = 0
 value.P_extends = E_string
 value.P_empty = E_any
 value.P_propertylist = E_varlist
 value.P_container = E_type
 value.P_allowtypes = E_typelist
 value.P_func = E_func
 value.P_isntaive = false
}

// V_type_startup
func V_type_startup() *Type_type {
 var t_variable *Type_type = T_type
 var e_variable *Type_type = E_type
 V_type_initialize(
  e_variable)
 V_type_t_startup(
  t_variable,
  "vx/core",
  "type",
  E_string,
  e_variable.type_any)
 return t_variable
}

// V_any_cast_type
func V_any_cast_type(
 type_type *Type_type) *Type_any {
 var output *Type_any = type_type.type_any
 if output == nil {
  println("Error:any-cast-type:Missing type_any:" + type_type.P_name)
  output = E_any
 }
 return output
}

// V_type_cast_any
func V_type_cast_any(
 type_any *Type_any) *Type_type {
 var output *Type_type = E_type
 var value, ok = type_any.backref.(*Type_type)
 if ok {
  output = value
 }
 return output
}

func V_type_code_from_any(
 type_scope *Type_scope,
 indent int,
 path string,
 type_any *Type_any) string {
 var output = ""
 var type_type *Type_type = V_type_cast_any(
  type_any)
 var type_lang *Type_lang = type_scope.P_lang
 var pkgnamen = V_code_pkgnamen(
  type_scope,
  V_pkgnamen_from_scope(
   type_scope))
 var typenamen = V_code_type_name(
  type_scope,
  type_type)
 switch type_lang {
 case C_lang_go:
  if pkgnamen == type_type.P_pkgname {
   pkgnamen = ""
  }
  output = pkgnamen + "T_" + typenamen
 default:
  output = pkgnamen + "t_" + typenamen
 }
 return output
}

func V_type_listkey_from_any(
 type_any *Type_any) []string {
 var output []string = []string{}
 var type_type = type_any.P_type
 var type_varlist = type_type.P_propertylist
 if type_varlist != E_varlist {
  var listvar = type_varlist.P_listvar
  for _, type_var := range listvar {
   var prop *Type_string = type_var.P_name
   var propn string = V_stringn_cast_string(prop)
   output = append(output, propn)
  }
 }
 return output
}

func V_type_new_from_pkgnamen_namen_extends_type_native(
 pkgnamen string,
 namen string,
 extends_string *Type_string,
 type_type *Type_type,
 isnativen bool) *Type_type {
 var t_variable *Type_type = V_type_create()
 var e_variable *Type_type = V_type_create()
 V_type_initialize(
  e_variable)
 V_type_t_startup(
  t_variable,
  pkgnamen,
  namen,
  extends_string,
  e_variable.type_any)
 if type_type != E_type {
  t_variable.P_container = type_type
  t_variable.P_allowtypes = V_typelist_from_listtype(
   []*Type_type{
    type_type})
 }
 t_variable.P_isnative = isnativen
 return t_variable
}

func V_type_new_from_scope_namen_return_varlist_value(
 type_scope *Type_scope,
 namen string,
 return_type *Type_type,
 type_varlist *Type_varlist,
 value_any *Type_any) *Type_type {
 var pkgnamen string = type_scope.P_package.P_path
 var t_variable *Type_type = V_type_create()
 var e_variable *Type_type = V_type_create()
 V_type_initialize(
  e_variable)
 V_type_t_startup(
  t_variable,
  pkgnamen,
  namen,
  C_extends_func,
  e_variable.type_any)
 var type_func *Type_func = V_func_create()
 type_func.P_return = return_type
 type_func.P_arglist = type_varlist
 type_func.P_value = value_any
 t_variable.P_func = type_func
 var output *Type_type = t_variable
 return output
}

func V_type_t_startup(
 type_type *Type_type,
 pkgname string,
 name string,
 extends_string *Type_string,
 empty_any *Type_any) {
 var path string = ""
 switch pkgname {
 case "":
  path = name
 default:
  path = pkgname + "/" + name
 }
 type_type.P_path = path
 type_type.P_pkgname = pkgname
 type_type.P_name = name
 type_type.P_alias = name
 type_type.P_idx = 0
 type_type.P_extends = extends_string
 type_type.type_generic = V_generic_new_code(
  V_type_code_from_any)
 type_type.type_any = V_any_from_type_backref(type_type, type_type)
 type_type.type_any.P_const = V_const_type(type_type)
 type_type.type_any.P_type = type_type
 type_type.P_empty = empty_any
 type_type.P_propertylist = V_varlist_from_listvar(
  []*Type_var{
   V_var_new_private_from_namen_type("type-generic", T_generic),
   V_var_new_public_from_namen_type("path", T_stringn),
   V_var_new_public_from_namen_type("pkgname", T_stringn),
   V_var_new_public_from_namen_type("name", T_stringn),
   V_var_new_public_from_namen_type("alias", T_stringn),
   V_var_new_public_from_namen_type("idx", T_intn),
   V_var_new_public_from_namen_type("extends", T_string),
   V_var_new_public_from_namen_type("empty", T_any),
   V_var_new_public_from_namen_type("propertylist", T_varlist),
   V_var_new_public_from_namen_type("container", T_type),
   V_var_new_public_from_namen_type("allowtypes", T_typelist),
   V_var_new_public_from_namen_type("func", T_func),
  })
 type_type.P_container = E_type
 type_type.P_allowtypes = E_typelist
 type_type.P_func = E_func
 type_type.P_isnative = false
 empty_any.P_const = V_const_empty(type_type)
}

// V_type_from_any
func V_type_from_any(
 type_any *Type_any) *Type_type {
 var output = type_any.P_type
 return output
}
